Terms & Disclaimer

ETHERSIM · ethersim.ai — free, open source (MIT) · last updated 26 Jun 2026

The short version: ETHERSIM is a free, open-source tool for exploring and visualizing mathematical dynamical systems, made for curiosity, learning, and art. It is provided as is, with no warranty. Use it at your own risk and enjoy it.

What ETHERSIM is

An interactive visualizer for dynamical systems — strange attractors, maps, surfaces, fractals, and more — running in your browser. It exists to make these systems beautiful and approachable. The renderings are illustrative approximations: they come from finite-precision numerical integration tuned for visual appeal, not from publication-grade computation.

Not for decisions that matter

ETHERSIM is for exploration and education. Do not rely on it for scientific, engineering, financial, medical, or any safety-critical purpose. Chaotic systems are, by nature, sensitive to initial conditions and numerical detail; treat what you see as a visualization, not as authoritative data.

⚠ Photosensitivity: some simulations and the demo/screensaver mode include rapid motion, flashing, and high-contrast color. If you are sensitive to flashing visuals, please use caution.

Requirements & availability

The GPU-accelerated path needs a modern browser with WebGPU (e.g. Chrome/Edge 113+, Safari 18+); otherwise it falls back to WebGL2. Performance varies by device. This is a personal, self-hosted project — availability, features, and these terms may change at any time without notice.
